name: TrueReview
blurb: Analyzes Google reviews for suspicious patterns and shows the adjusted “true” rating.
difficulty: The hard part is proving a pattern is real and not just noise.
problem: Restaurant ratings get gamed. A place with a hundred glowing five-star reviews can still be average — the reviews just look similar.
I wanted the rating a place actually deserves, not the one the review pattern produces.
built: A tool that pulls Google reviews, looks for suspicious patterns — bursts of reviews, repetitive language, one-sided stars — and shows an adjusted “true” rating.
The hard part is proving a pattern is real and not just noise.
outcome: The repo stays private until it ships.
